meta.title: Vendor GST Mismatch Validation: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Locate and execute Vendor GST Mismatch Validation to compare invoice GST with vendor-master GST and verify that it is refused or absent for a non-AP Executive but available to an AP Executive on the specified Growth tenant.
Sign in as the two role-specific users and compare their authorization outcomes.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Locate and execute Vendor GST Mismatch Validation to compare invoice GST with vendor-master GST and verify that it is refused or absent for a non-AP Executive but available to an AP Executive on the specified Growth tenant.; Sign in as the two role-specific users and compare their authorization outcomes.

args.need: sign in as the non-AP Executive user and the AP Executive on the specified Growth tenant, attempt Vendor GST Mismatch Validation for an invoice whose GST differs from the vendor master, and record whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the AP Executive
